newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: US envoy says no agreement at Tues UN Iraq debate.
newsitem.headline: US envoy says no agreement at Tues UN Iraq debate.

text.p: United States ambassador to the United Nations Edward Gnehm said Tuesday that he briefed the Security Council about U.S. military actions against Iraq and expected a decision on council action to take several days.

"The council is talking about actions they may take and in that regard...the debate in the council in the last couple of hours has been entirely centered on Iraqi actions in the north and how it is appropriate for the council to react and we haven't yet reached that agreement yet," Gnehm told reporters. "That will happen through the informal consulting process over the next few days," he added.
